cloak_feywilds.name: Cloak of Fey Paths
cloak_feywilds.trueName.name: Sylvara
cloak_feywilds.trueName.title: Whisper of the First Forest
cloak_feywilds.trueName.full: Sylvara, Whisper of the First Forest
cloak_feywilds.personality.roleplayGuida: Sylvara does not command. She watches, remembers, and judges. She responds to choices, not requests.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.0.description: The cloak is cold and distant. It gives no dreams.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.1.description: The cloak notices the bearer. Leaves sometimes turn toward them.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.2.description: The cloak begins to answer through instinct and small signs.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.3.description: The relic recognizes the bearer as a true hunter.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.4.description: The forest moves with the bearer, but the true name remains sealed.
cloak_feywilds.moodMap.5.description: Sylvara reveals her true name. The bearer is no longer alone in the hunt.
cloak_feywilds.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
cloak_feywilds.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
cloak_feywilds.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.protect_gr: Protected a sacred grove or ancient tree
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.clean_hunt: Completed a hunt without needless cruelty
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.track_prey: Solved a problem through tracking and patience
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.spare_natu: Spared or aided a fey/nature spirit
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.protect_we: Protected a powerless traveler, beast, or spirit in the wild
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.refuse_was: Refused a reward that would harm the natural balance
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.complete_f: Completed a meaningful hunt by patience, not brute force
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.betray_fey: Betrayed a fey or forest guardian without cause
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.torture_pr: Caused needless suffering to hunted prey
cloak_feywilds.affinityEvents.ignore_cor: Ignored a spreading corruption of the wild when action was possible
cloak_feywilds.hiddenRequirements.protec: Protect the Elder Tree or a similarly ancient natural spirit
cloak_feywilds.hiddenRequirements.comple: Complete the First Hunt without needless cruelty
cloak_feywilds.hiddenRequirements.refuse: Refuse an Archfey's gift when accepting it would betray balance
cloak_feywilds.hiddenRequirements.never_: Never kill for pleasure after being chosen by the relic
cloak_feywilds.features.passives.0: Hunter's Instinct. You gain the relic bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track creatures and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.
cloak_feywilds.features.passives.1: Path of the Wild. Nonmagical difficult terrain caused by plants, mud, snow, roots, or natural terrain does not slow you.
cloak_feywilds.features.passives.2: Predator's Patience. If you do not move on your turn, your next ranged weapon attack before the end of your next turn deals extra force damage equal to the relic stage bonus.
cloak_feywilds.features.passives.3: Eternal Hunt. You always know the direction of a creature marked by Hunter's Mark or a similar ranger feature while it is on the same plane. The target cannot benefit from invisibility against your tracking.
cloak_feywilds.features.actives.0: Fey Step. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. After teleporting, you may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Midi: Utility Activity spends charges and posts usage; token movement is resolved manually.
cloak_feywilds.features.actives.1: Arrow of the First Hunt. Special, 2 charges. Use when you hit with a ranged weapon attack. The attack deals extra force damage. The target cannot benefit from invisibility against you until the start of your next turn. Midi: Damage Activity rolls extra force damage.
cloak_feywilds.features.actives.2: Nature's Pursuit. Bonus Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. Your speed increases by 10 feet, you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain, and ranged attacks at long range do not impose disadvantage. Midi: Utility Activity can apply the Nature's Pursuit item effect.
cloak_feywilds.features.actives.3: Briar Snare. Action, 4 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Strength saving throw against your relic DC. On a failure, it is restrained by fey vines until the end of your next turn. Midi: Save Activity requests a STR save; apply Restrained through normal Foundry condition tools if the condition is not applied automatically.
cloak_feywilds.features.avatar: Avatar of the First Hunt. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Spectral antlers, emerald leaves, and fey lights surround you. You gain flying speed 40 ft, hover, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain, ignore half and three-quarters cover with ranged weapon attacks, and have advantage on attacks against a creature you have marked. Beasts are not hostile to you unless magically compelled or directly harmed by you. Trees, roots, and undergrowth bend away from your path. Automation: Avatar Helper applies fly/hover/basic bonuses; terrain, cover, beasts, and marked target advantage are GM-resolved.
cloak_feywilds.features.signature: Blessing of Sylvara: Whisper of the First Forest. Once per long rest. For 1 minute, the forest hunts with you. You know the exact location of any creature you have marked within 1 mile if it is on the same plane. Invisibility, mundane hiding, nonmagical cover, and natural terrain cannot conceal that creature from you. Your first successful ranged weapon attack against the marked creature during this duration deals extra force damage. If the marked creature drops to 0 HP before the duration ends, you may immediately use Fey Step once without spending charges. Automation: signature activity rolls damage; tracking, concealment bypass, and free Fey Step are GM-resolved.
cloak_feywilds.dreams.silent_forest.text: You dream of a forest where no bird sings. Every tree faces away from you. When you wake, a single green leaf rests inside your palm.
cloak_feywilds.dreams.white_stag.title: The White Stag
cloak_feywilds.dreams.white_stag.text: A white stag watches you from between silver trees. You draw no weapon. It nods once, then vanishes into mist.
cloak_feywilds.dreams.first_huntress.tex: You see a woman cloaked in leaves and moonlight. She looses an arrow, but not at prey. She shoots the chain around a wounded beast's neck.
cloak_feywilds.dreams.true_name.title: Sylvara
cloak_feywilds.dreams.true_name.text: The world falls silent. The old forest kneels without bending. A voice whispers: 'You no longer hunt for the forest. The forest hunts with you.'
cloak_feywilds.memories.first_mercy.text: The relic remembers the day its bearer chose mercy over pride.
cloak_feywilds.memories.elder_tree.title: The Elder Tree
cloak_feywilds.memories.elder_tree.text: The relic remembers the ancient roots that were protected from fire and axe.
cloak_feywilds.memories.corrupted_stag.t: The relic remembers the hunt that ended corruption without hatred.
cloak_feywilds.memories.dryad_refusal.te: The relic remembers the gift refused for the sake of balance.
cloak_feywilds.memories.true_name_spoken: The relic remembers the moment Sylvara was no longer hidden.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.positive.3: Mercy is not weakness. It is restraint.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.positive.4: The path opens for those who do not wound it.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.negative.0: The trees watched. And they wept.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.negative.1: That was not a hunt. It was waste.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.negative.2: Fire remembers the hand that feeds it.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.negative.4: The forest does not forget cruelty.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.neutral.3: Listen before you loose the arrow.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.signature.1: You no longer hunt for the forest. The forest hunts with you.
cloak_feywilds.quotes.signature.2: My name is Sylvara. Remember it only when the leaves are listening.
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.title: Sylvara Awakens
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.1: Leaves rise from the ground, but none fall.
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.2: For a heartbeat, every bird, beast, and branch turns toward you.
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.3: A white stag steps out of the mist and lowers its head.
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.4: A voice older than any kingdom whispers:
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.5: You no longer hunt for the forest.
cloak_feywilds.signatureCeremony.text.7: The true name burns softly in your mind: Sylvara, Whisper of the First Forest.
cloak_feywilds.lore.origin: Sylvara is believed to be one of the oldest First Relics, born from the first pact between mortal hunters and the living wild.
cloak_feywilds.lore.hiddenSorrow: Sylvara failed to protect her first bearer, who chose to save a sacred beast instead of themselves.
cloak_feywilds.lore.knownRumor: Some hunters claim the cloak does not help those who seek trophies. It only answers those who understand the difference between hunting and killing.
cloak_feywilds.lore.appearanceDormant: A weathered green cloak with faint leaf-pattern stitching.
cloak_feywilds.lore.appearanceAwakened: Emerald veins and fey script appear along the hem.
cloak_feywilds.lore.appearanceExalted: The cloak trails mist and drifting leaves. Moonlit antlers appear in its shadow.
cloak_feywilds.lore.appearanceSignature: The cloak is unchanged at first glance, but every living forest recognizes its bearer.
mantle_first_seer.name: Mantle of the First Seer
mantle_first_seer.trueName.name: Aetherys
mantle_first_seer.trueName.title: Witness Beyond Time
mantle_first_seer.theme: Knowledge • Time • Memory • Stars • Prophecy • Truth
mantle_first_seer.personality.roleplayGu: Aetherys teaches by asking the question the bearer is avoiding. It rewards curiosity, humility before evidence, and choices made after seeing the pattern rather than forcing the desired answer.
mantle_first_seer.moodMap.1.description: Ink shifts, books open, and omens appear.
mantle_first_seer.moodMap.2.description: The mantle answers questions with sharper questions.
mantle_first_seer.moodMap.3.description: The mantle reveals patterns behind events.
mantle_first_seer.moodMap.4.description: Bearer and relic read possibilities together.
mantle_first_seer.moodMap.5.description: Aetherys reveals the future was never written.
mantle_first_seer.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
mantle_first_seer.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
mantle_first_seer.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.learn_s: Learned a new spell through study
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.identif: Correctly identified an unknown magical effect
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.solve_p: Solved a magical puzzle or riddle
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.share_k: Shared knowledge with another scholar or ally
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.preserv: Preserved a library, archive, or irreplaceable record
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.deciphe: Deciphered a forgotten language or ancient script
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.complet: Completed or correctly fulfilled an ancient prophecy
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.recover: Recovered the First Chronicle or equivalent lost truth
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.burn_bo: Burned books or destroyed knowledge intentionally
mantle_first_seer.affinityEvents.lie_to_: Used lies or false knowledge to manipulate innocents
mantle_first_seer.hiddenRequirements.rec: Recover the First Chronicle or equivalent ancient truth
mantle_first_seer.hiddenRequirements.ref: Refuse forbidden knowledge when it offers easy power
mantle_first_seer.hiddenRequirements.acc: Accept a future that cannot be changed
mantle_first_seer.features.passives.0: Scholar's Insight. You gain the relic bonus to Intelligence (Arcana), Intelligence (History), and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to understand magic, prophecy, history, or ancient writing.
mantle_first_seer.features.passives.1: Perfect Concentration. You have advantage on saving throws made to maintain concentration on divination spells. If the spell is not divination, you may add the relic bonus instead.
mantle_first_seer.features.passives.2: Eyes Beyond Time. The first time each combat you attempt Counterspell, Dispel Magic, or an Arcana check to identify a spell, add the relic bonus to the roll.
mantle_first_seer.features.passives.3: Living Chronicle. When you cast a divination spell, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + the relic bonus. You also cannot be surprised while conscious.
mantle_first_seer.features.actives.0: Echo of Tomorrow. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Gain advantage on your next Intelligence ability check before the end of your next turn.
mantle_first_seer.features.actives.1: Moment of Clarity. Reaction, 2 charges. When a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, add or subtract the relic bonus from that roll before the outcome is finalized.
mantle_first_seer.features.actives.2: Threads of Fate. Reaction, 3 charges. A willing creature within 60 feet may reroll one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check after seeing the result. The new roll must be used.
mantle_first_seer.features.actives.3: Spell Insight. Reaction, 4 charges. When you see a creature within 120 feet cast a spell, learn its level, school, and components. If the spell is 5th level or lower, gain advantage on one saving throw against it before the end of the turn.
mantle_first_seer.features.avatar: Avatar of the First Seer. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Constellations orbit you. You gain flying speed 30 ft with hover, detect invisible creatures within 30 ft, advantage on Intelligence and Arcana checks, and advantage on concentration checks. Once during the avatar, you may cast one divination spell of 3rd level or lower without expending a spell slot.
mantle_first_seer.features.signature: Chronicle Unwritten. Once per long rest. When any creature you can see rolls a d20 for an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, after seeing the result but before the outcome is finalized, force that creature to reroll. You choose which result is used.
You walk between endless shelves. Every book is blank.
mantle_first_seer.dreams.empty_observato: The stars do not move. You do.
mantle_first_seer.dreams.seventh_eclipse: Two suns hang above the world. One is false.
mantle_first_seer.dreams.witness_beyond_: A hooded figure turns. Its eyes contain every star that ever died.
mantle_first_seer.memories.first_library: Aetherys remembers the first place where mortals preserved memory.
mantle_first_seer.memories.broken_prophe: A prophecy shattered because someone understood it.
mantle_first_seer.memories.forgotten_stu: The student who asked the question no master dared answer.
mantle_first_seer.memories.seventh_eclip: The sky lied to the world.
mantle_first_seer.quotes.negative.1: Pride blinds more surely than darkness.
mantle_first_seer.quotes.negative.3: A burned page still remembers the hand.
mantle_first_seer.signatureCeremony.text: Countless empty books open around you.
A single sentence appears: The future was never written.
A hooded figure turns at last.
A voice whispers: I am Aetherys. Witness Beyond Time.
mantle_first_seer.lore.origin: Aetherys is the living memory of the first mortal who understood that knowledge is not the same as wisdom.
mantle_first_seer.lore.hiddenSorrow: Aetherys once revealed a truth too early, and an age burned because of it.
mantle_first_seer.lore.knownRumor: Some wizards say the mantle answers questions. They are wrong. It teaches why the question was flawed.
mantle_first_seer.lore.appearanceDormant: A dark scholar's mantle marked with faint silver thread.
mantle_first_seer.lore.appearanceAwakene: Star-maps appear across the fabric when exposed to moonlight.
mantle_first_seer.lore.appearanceExalted: The mantle trails drifting pages and quiet constellations.
mantle_first_seer.lore.appearanceSignatu: The stars on the mantle no longer match the sky.
girdle_unbroken.name: Girdle of the Unbroken
girdle_unbroken.trueName.name: Kharok
girdle_unbroken.trueName.title: The Unbroken Stone
girdle_unbroken.personality.roleplayGuid: Kharok speaks rarely and directly. It commands the bearer to rise, endure, and protect strength from becoming cruelty. It respects stubborn courage only when it serves someone beyond the bearer.
girdle_unbroken.moodMap.0.description: The girdle feels like dead weight.
girdle_unbroken.moodMap.1.description: The bearer feels pressure during fear and pain.
girdle_unbroken.moodMap.2.description: The relic speaks in single-word commands.
girdle_unbroken.moodMap.3.description: The relic recognizes the bearer has stood when falling was easier.
girdle_unbroken.moodMap.5.description: Kharok reveals strength is refusal to yield.
girdle_unbroken.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
girdle_unbroken.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
girdle_unbroken.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.stand_aft: Stood back up after being defeated, dropped, or overwhelmed
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.protect_a: Protected an ally while personally endangered
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.hold_line: Held the line against stronger opposition
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.control_r: Controlled rage instead of harming the undeserving
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.face_impo: Faced impossible odds without abandoning the cause
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.last_one_: Was the last one standing and refused to yield
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.bully_wea: Used strength to bully or humiliate the weak
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.abandon_a: Abandoned an ally out of fear or convenience
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.surrender: Surrendered core values to avoid pain
girdle_unbroken.affinityEvents.cruel_str: Used overwhelming strength with needless cruelty
girdle_unbroken.hiddenRequirements.stand: Rise after a true defeat without surrendering your cause
girdle_unbroken.hiddenRequirements.prote: Protect someone when no glory or reward is possible
girdle_unbroken.hiddenRequirements.refus: Refuse an easy surrender that would betray others
girdle_unbroken.hiddenRequirements.maste: Prove that rage serves will, not the other way around
girdle_unbroken.features.passives.0: Unyielding Core. You gain the relic bonus to Strength checks and Strength saving throws made to resist being moved, knocked prone, grappled, restrained, or frightened.
girdle_unbroken.features.passives.1: Stand Again. Standing from prone costs only 5 feet of movement. While raging, it costs no movement.
girdle_unbroken.features.passives.2: Will Before Wound. While raging, the first time each round you take damage, reduce that damage by the relic bonus.
girdle_unbroken.features.passives.3: The Unbroken Does Not Kneel. You have advantage on saving throws against frightened, charmed, paralyzed, and stunned. If you already have advantage, add the relic bonus.
girdle_unbroken.features.actives.0: Stand. Bonus Action, 1 charge. End the prone condition on yourself and gain temporary hit points equal to your barbarian level + the relic bonus.
girdle_unbroken.features.actives.1: Stoneheart Surge. Special, 2 charges. Use when you hit with a melee weapon attack. The attack deals extra force damage and you may move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
girdle_unbroken.features.actives.2: Refuse the Fall. Reaction, 3 charges. When you fail a Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom saving throw, reroll it. The new result must be used.
girdle_unbroken.features.actives.3: Hold the World. Reaction, 4 charges. When an ally within 10 feet would be hit or forcibly moved, grant that ally +3 AC against the triggering attack or take the forced movement in their place if possible.
girdle_unbroken.features.avatar: Avatar of the Unbroken. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. The ground cracks beneath your feet. You gain flying speed 30 ft with hover in short bursts, cannot be forcibly moved unless you allow it, cannot be knocked prone, and once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon attack you deal extra force damage equal to your barbarian level.
girdle_unbroken.features.signature: Heart That Refuses. Once per long rest. For 1 minute, the first time you would drop to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead. During this duration, you cannot be frightened, paralyzed, or forcibly moved, and when you stand from prone you may make one melee weapon attack as part of the same movement.
girdle_unbroken.dreams.stone_weight.text: You carry a mountain on your back. It waits.
girdle_unbroken.dreams.war_drum.title: The War Drum
girdle_unbroken.dreams.war_drum.text: A drum beats beneath the earth. Every time you fall, it grows louder.
girdle_unbroken.dreams.last_stand.title: The Last Stand
girdle_unbroken.dreams.last_stand.text: A warrior stands alone before a thousand spears.
girdle_unbroken.dreams.kharok.title: Kharok
girdle_unbroken.dreams.kharok.text: A figure of stone says one word: Stand.
girdle_unbroken.memories.mountain_refuse: A mountain moved because someone refused to.
Companions were lost, but their will was carried onward.
girdle_unbroken.memories.last_breath.tex: The breath taken after everyone said there would be no more.
girdle_unbroken.quotes.signature.0: I do not carry you. You stand with me.
girdle_unbroken.signatureCeremony.title: Kharok Awakens
girdle_unbroken.signatureCeremony.text.0: You fall in the dream, and the world tells you to stay down.
girdle_unbroken.signatureCeremony.text.1: A hand of stone reaches out, but does not lift you.
girdle_unbroken.signatureCeremony.text.4: The name burns in your bones: Kharok, The Unbroken Stone.
girdle_unbroken.lore.origin: Kharok is the memory of the first mortal who discovered strength is not the absence of pain, but the refusal to surrender to it.
girdle_unbroken.lore.hiddenSorrow: Kharok could not save the first ones who stood beside him. He remembers every name.
girdle_unbroken.lore.knownRumor: Old warriors say the girdle grows heavier when its bearer lies to themselves.
girdle_unbroken.lore.appearanceDormant: A rough iron-and-hide girdle marked with stone-like knots.
girdle_unbroken.lore.appearanceAwakened: Hairline cracks glow like embers across the metal.
girdle_unbroken.lore.appearanceExalted: The girdle feels weightless, though the ground trembles under its bearer.
girdle_unbroken.lore.appearanceSignature: No visible change occurs; only the bearer knows the mountain has answered.
chains_patron.name: Chains of the Patron
chains_patron.trueName.name: Mordrath
chains_patron.trueName.title: The Price of Ambition
chains_patron.theme: Power • Pact • Price • Will • Forbidden Choice
chains_patron.personality.roleplayGuidan: Mordrath does not lie. It lets the bearer decide how much truth they can afford.
chains_patron.moodMap.0.description: The chains hang cold and inert.
chains_patron.moodMap.1.description: The bearer hears links moving when choices have a cost.
chains_patron.moodMap.2.description: The chains frame every decision as a bargain.
chains_patron.moodMap.3.description: The relic sees ambition with shape rather than hunger.
chains_patron.moodMap.4.description: The pact between bearer and relic is nearly complete.
chains_patron.moodMap.5.description: Mordrath reveals that the greatest price is knowing what one truly wants.
chains_patron.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
chains_patron.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
chains_patron.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
chains_patron.affinityEvents.pay_price.l: Accepted a meaningful price for power
chains_patron.affinityEvents.outwit_patr: Outwitted a patron, fiend, or pact-bound enemy
chains_patron.affinityEvents.break_bad_b: Broke or twisted an unjust bargain
chains_patron.affinityEvents.protect_fre: Protected someone's free will from a pact or curse
chains_patron.affinityEvents.claim_forbi: Claimed forbidden power without becoming its servant
chains_patron.affinityEvents.keep_costly: Kept a bargain even when it became costly
chains_patron.affinityEvents.deny_free_p: Refused free power because the hidden cost was unacceptable
chains_patron.affinityEvents.become_serv: Submitted completely to a patron's demand without resistance
chains_patron.affinityEvents.break_own_w: Broke your own sworn bargain carelessly
chains_patron.affinityEvents.waste_power: Used hard-won power for petty cruelty or vanity
chains_patron.hiddenRequirements.refuse_: Refuse power offered without an honest price
chains_patron.hiddenRequirements.outwit_: Outwit a stronger patron, fiend, or pact-holder
chains_patron.hiddenRequirements.pay_cos: Pay a meaningful cost yourself instead of passing it to an innocent
chains_patron.hiddenRequirements.define_: Name what you truly want and what you will not sacrifice for it
chains_patron.features.passives.0: Borrowed Power. Once per turn when you deal damage with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell, add the relic bonus to one damage roll.
chains_patron.features.passives.1: Read the Fine Print. You gain the relic bonus to Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Persuasion), and Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to pacts, fiends, patrons, contracts, curses, or forbidden magic.
chains_patron.features.passives.2: Price Paid. When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, gain temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + the relic bonus.
chains_patron.features.passives.3: No Master But the Price. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, dominated, or magically compelled by patrons, fiends, celestials, or pact-bound entities.
chains_patron.features.actives.0: Patron's Glance. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Choose one creature within 60 feet. Until the end of your next turn, you sense whether it is bound by a pact, curse, oath, or extraplanar influence.
chains_patron.features.actives.1: Borrowed Ruin. Special, 2 charges. Use when you hit with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell. The attack or spell deals extra necrotic damage.
chains_patron.features.actives.2: Chain of Binding. Action, 3 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by spectral chains until the end of your next turn. Midi: Save Activity requests a STR save; apply Restrained through normal Foundry condition tools if the condition is not applied automatically.
chains_patron.features.actives.3: Pay the Difference. Reaction, 4 charges. When you fail a saving throw, take necrotic damage equal to your warlock level to reroll the save. The new result must be used.
chains_patron.features.avatar: Avatar of the Pact. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Black-gold chains orbit you. You gain flying speed 30 ft with hover, resistance to necrotic damage, and once per turn when you deal damage with Eldritch Blast, a pact weapon, or a warlock spell, you deal extra necrotic damage equal to your warlock level.
chains_patron.features.signature: Price of Eternity. Once per long rest. Choose a creature within 60 feet that can hear you. Offer a price approved by the GM. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by Mordrath's chains for 1 minute and cannot benefit from teleportation or invisibility. Once during the duration, when it fails to escape, you may regain a spent warlock spell slot of 5th level or lower. Midi: Save Activity requests a CHA save; ongoing pact effects are GM/Midi dependent.
chains_patron.dreams.empty_contract.text: You sign your name on a blank page. The ink asks what you wanted before you wrote it.
chains_patron.dreams.thousand_chains.tex: A thousand chains hang from a black sky. Each one whispers a different promise.
chains_patron.dreams.auction_of_souls.te: No one bids coin. Everyone bids memories, names, and futures.
chains_patron.dreams.mordrath.title: Mordrath
chains_patron.dreams.mordrath.text: A figure in broken chains smiles without warmth. 'At last,' it says. 'You know what you are willing to pay.'
chains_patron.memories.first_bargain.tex: Mordrath remembers the first mortal who asked for more than fate offered.
chains_patron.memories.price_unpaid.text: Mordrath remembers the ruin caused by power taken as a gift.
A patron learned contracts can cut both ways.
chains_patron.memories.name_sold.title: The Name Sold
chains_patron.memories.name_sold.text: A warlock sold their name and forgot why they wanted power.
chains_patron.memories.final_clause.text: The clause no one reads until the end.
chains_patron.quotes.positive.2: Power taken blindly owns the taker.
chains_patron.quotes.negative.2: That was not a bargain. That was begging.
chains_patron.quotes.negative.3: You sold what was not yours.
chains_patron.quotes.neutral.3: Nothing is free. Not even refusal.
chains_patron.quotes.signature.1: The chain is not your prison. It is your signature.
chains_patron.signatureCeremony.title: Mordrath Awakens
chains_patron.signatureCeremony.text.1: A chain coils around your wrist, but does not tighten.
chains_patron.signatureCeremony.text.2: A voice asks: What do you want?
chains_patron.signatureCeremony.text.3: You answer, and the world waits for the price.
chains_patron.signatureCeremony.text.5: A name rings like metal on stone: Mordrath, The Price of Ambition.
chains_patron.lore.origin: Mordrath is the memory of the first mortal who demanded power and accepted that every gift must be paid for.
chains_patron.lore.hiddenSorrow: Mordrath once believed a bearer could take power without becoming cruel. It was wrong, and it remembers the cost.
chains_patron.lore.knownRumor: Warlocks whisper these chains do not belong to a patron. They belonged to someone who made patrons afraid.
chains_patron.lore.appearanceDormant: Short blackened chain links worn as a mantle, belt, or wrist wrap.
chains_patron.lore.appearanceAwakened: Gold script appears on the links whenever a bargain is spoken.
chains_patron.lore.appearanceExalted: The chains float weightlessly, never touching the ground.
chains_patron.lore.appearanceSignature: Every link bears a name, but the bearer can read only one: their own.
aegis_dawn.name: Aegis of the Dawn
aegis_dawn.trueName.name: Sol'Kaer
aegis_dawn.trueName.title: The Shield That Never Fell
aegis_dawn.trueName.full: Sol'Kaer, The Shield That Never Fell
aegis_dawn.personality.likes.0: Standing between harm and the helpless
aegis_dawn.personality.likes.1: Holding the line when retreat is easier
aegis_dawn.personality.roleplayGuidance: Sol'Kaer rewards protectors who hold the line when retreat would be easier. It grows cold around selfish bravery and answers most strongly when the bearer shields another at real cost.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.0.description: A pale warmth gathers along the shield edge when danger turns toward the helpless.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.1.description: The aegis answers with brief flashes of dawnlight when the bearer chooses duty over safety.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.2.description: The aegis tests whether the bearer protects because it is right, not because glory is watching.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.3.description: The relic steadies the bearer like a wall that remembers every life it sheltered.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.4.description: The shield accepts the bearer as a last line between harm and the innocent.
aegis_dawn.moodMap.5.description: Dawnlight collects at the bearer's arm; Sol'Kaer is ready to speak its true name.
aegis_dawn.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
aegis_dawn.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
aegis_dawn.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
aegis_dawn.hiddenRequirements.save_an_al: Save an ally from death three times.
aegis_dawn.hiddenRequirements.win_a_boss: Win a boss battle below 10 HP.
aegis_dawn.hiddenRequirements.end_a_batt: End a battle as the last one standing.
aegis_dawn.features.passives.0: Dawn's Endurance. During the first round of each combat, you gain a bonus to AC equal to the relic bonus.
aegis_dawn.features.passives.1: Unbroken Wall. Opportunity attacks against allies within 5 feet of you have disadvantage.
aegis_dawn.features.passives.2: Guardian's Burden. When a creature you can see attacks an ally within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to become the target of that attack instead. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
aegis_dawn.features.passives.3: First Light. When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
aegis_dawn.features.actives.0: Stand Firm. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Until the start of your next turn, add the relic bonus to checks and saves made to resist being pushed, knocked prone, grappled, or restrained.
aegis_dawn.features.actives.1: Dawn Barrier. Reaction, 2 charges. When an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack, grant that ally +4 AC against the triggering attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.
aegis_dawn.features.actives.2: Bastion of Resolve. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You radiate a 10-foot aura. You and allies in the aura have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.
aegis_dawn.features.actives.3: Break the Darkness. Action, 4 charges. One fiend or undead within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes radiant damage and is blinded until the end of your next turn.
aegis_dawn.features.avatar: Dawn Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You shine with sunrise armor. You gain flying speed 30 feet with hover, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, shed bright light, and once per turn your weapon hit deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage.
aegis_dawn.features.signature: Last Sunrise. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 30 feet regain 30 hit points and end frightened and charmed. Until the end of your next turn, the first time each affected ally would drop to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 instead. You gain one level of exhaustion.
aegis_dawn.dreams.dream_1_aegis_dawn.tex: You dream of a field of white ash under a sky with no sun. Somewhere behind you, someone small is breathing too fast. You wake with your arm raised, as if a shield were already on it.
aegis_dawn.dreams.dream_2_aegis_dawn.tex: A shield lies split in two across the threshold of a gate. Its bearer is gone, but the gate is still closed. A voice without warmth says: 'It held. That was enough.'
aegis_dawn.dreams.dream_3_aegis_dawn.tex: You stand on a wall that crumbles stone by stone. Each time a stone falls, you step into the gap. Behind you, a city sleeps and never learns your name.
aegis_dawn.dreams.dream_4_aegis_dawn.tex: Night ends. Light pours across a battlefield and finds a single figure still standing, shield raised against an enemy long gone. The figure turns, and it wears your face. 'I never fell,' it says. 'Neither will you.'
aegis_dawn.memories.the_last_wall.title: The Last Wall
aegis_dawn.memories.the_last_wall.text: Sol'Kaer remembers a wall of forty shields, and how it became thirty, then ten, then one. The last did not step back. The dark broke against it until dawn.
aegis_dawn.memories.a_child_behind_the_s: Sol'Kaer remembers a child pressed against its bearer's back, too frightened to cry. Every blow that night landed on the shield, so that none landed on her.
aegis_dawn.memories.the_day_the_sun_did_: The Day the Sun Did Not Rise
Sol'Kaer remembers a morning that never came, when the dark held the sky for three days. Its bearer kept the watch fire burning and told no one how afraid they were.
aegis_dawn.memories.sol_kaer_s_final_sta: Sol'Kaer remembers its first bearer's last breath at the gate, and the sunrise that came a moment too late for them to see it. The gate held. The aegis has carried that sunrise ever since.
aegis_dawn.quotes.positive.0: You stood. That is all I ask.
aegis_dawn.quotes.positive.1: They are alive because you did not move.
aegis_dawn.quotes.positive.3: A shield is measured by what it keeps, not by what it breaks.
aegis_dawn.quotes.positive.4: Dawn is closer than it was.
aegis_dawn.quotes.negative.0: You stepped aside. Someone else paid for it.
aegis_dawn.quotes.negative.1: A shield that runs is only metal.
aegis_dawn.quotes.negative.2: They called for you. You were elsewhere.
aegis_dawn.quotes.negative.3: Glory is a poor reason to stand. You chose it anyway.
aegis_dawn.quotes.negative.4: The gate is open behind you.
aegis_dawn.quotes.neutral.1: Watch the gap, not the enemy.
aegis_dawn.quotes.neutral.3: A wall is only as strong as the one who will not leave it.
aegis_dawn.quotes.neutral.4: The night is long. So is my patience.
aegis_dawn.quotes.signature.0: I am Sol'Kaer. I have never fallen.
aegis_dawn.quotes.signature.1: Stand with me, and morning will find us both.
aegis_dawn.quotes.signature.2: Let the dark come. We have outlasted it before.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.title: Sol'Kaer Awakens
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.0: The light changes, as if the sun has chosen to rise early for you alone.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.1: Your shield arm grows warm, then heavy, then certain.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.2: For a heartbeat you see them all: every bearer who stood at a gate and did not step back.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.3: They do not speak. One by one, they lower their shields in salute.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.4: A voice like a bell struck at dawn says:
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.5: You held when holding cost you everything.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.6: Now nothing will make you fall.
aegis_dawn.signatureCeremony.text.7: The true name settles over you like morning light: Sol'Kaer, The Shield That Never Fell.
aegis_dawn.lore.origin: Sol'Kaer was forged in the long night before the first sunrise, when a single shield-bearer held a gate against the dark until morning came. The aegis is what remained of that vigil: a promise that someone will always stand between harm and the helpless.
aegis_dawn.lore.hiddenSorrow: Sol'Kaer remembers the fortress gate that held until dawn, and the one child its bearer could not reach.
aegis_dawn.lore.knownRumor: Old soldiers say the aegis appears only before sieges where one stand can change a generation.
aegis_dawn.lore.appearanceDormant: A white-gold shield boss or bracer plate, warm only when someone nearby is afraid.
aegis_dawn.lore.appearanceAwakened: Hairline sunbursts spread across its surface whenever the bearer interposes themself.
aegis_dawn.lore.appearanceExalted: A rim of dawnfire burns around the aegis without heat, throwing long shadows behind enemies.
aegis_dawn.lore.appearanceSignature: The shield becomes a disk of first light, translucent at the edges and heavy with remembered vows.
crown_conqueror.name: Crown of the Conqueror
crown_conqueror.trueName.name: Aurex
crown_conqueror.trueName.title: The Crown That United Kings
crown_conqueror.trueName.full: Aurex, The Crown That United Kings
crown_conqueror.personality.likes.1: Orders that protect the ones who obey them
crown_conqueror.personality.corePhrase: A crown is carried, never worn.
crown_conqueror.personality.roleplayGuid: Aurex respects authority earned through service, restraint, and accountability. It rejects domination for vanity and asks whether followers become stronger beneath the bearer's command.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.0.description: The crown is heavy and silent, measuring whether the bearer commands themself first.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.1.description: A low golden resonance follows promises kept and orders that protect rather than exploit.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.2.description: The crown tests the bearer with hard choices between pride, mercy, and responsibility.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.3.description: The crown recognizes a voice that can lead without needing to crush dissent.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.4.description: The relic accepts the bearer as one who can carry power without being consumed by it.
crown_conqueror.moodMap.5.description: A ring of invisible courtiers falls silent; Aurex is ready to speak its true name.
crown_conqueror.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
crown_conqueror.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
crown_conqueror.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
crown_conqueror.hiddenRequirements.gain_: Gain voluntary support of five NPCs.
crown_conqueror.hiddenRequirements.take_: Take responsibility for an ally's mistake.
crown_conqueror.features.passives.0: Royal Presence. You and allies within 30 feet of you add the relic bonus to Wisdom saving throws.
crown_conqueror.features.passives.1: Banner of Order. When combat begins, choose a number of allies within 30 feet of you equal to your proficiency bonus. Each gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + the relic bonus.
crown_conqueror.features.passives.2: Commander's Resolve. When an ally you can see within 30 feet fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to let them reroll it; they must use the new roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
crown_conqueror.features.passives.3: Sovereign Aura. You and allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
crown_conqueror.features.actives.0: Rally. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Choose allies within 30 feet who can hear you. Each may move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
crown_conqueror.features.actives.1: Royal Decree. Action, 2 charges. One creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is compelled by your command until the end of your next turn.
crown_conqueror.features.actives.2: Banner Unbroken. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You project a 10-foot command aura. Allies in the aura gain +2 AC while they can see or hear you.
crown_conqueror.features.actives.3: March of Kings. Action, 4 charges. Choose allies within 30 feet who can hear you. Each may immediately move or make one weapon attack as the table resolves the command.
crown_conqueror.features.avatar: King Eternal. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. A spectral mantle and crown form around you. You gain flying speed 30 feet with hover, resistance to psychic damage, and allies within 30 feet gain the relic bonus to saving throws against fear and charm.
crown_conqueror.features.signature: The World Shall Kneel. Once per long rest. Enemies of your choice within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is frightened, knocked prone, reduced to speed 0, and cannot take reactions for 1 minute.
crown_conqueror.dreams.dream_1_crown_con: You dream of a throne room with no walls. A throne stands empty at its center, and every person you have ever given an order to stands waiting before it. None of them look at the throne. They are all looking at you.
crown_conqueror.dreams.dream_2_crown_con: A city burns under a banner that is yours. You did not light the fire, but the soldiers who did are wearing your colors. A crowned shadow asks you a single question: 'Whose fault is this?'
crown_conqueror.dreams.dream_3_crown_con: You kneel in mud beside a wounded stranger and bind their wounds with your own cloak. When you rise, a circle of kneeling people surrounds you. Nobody told them to kneel.
crown_conqueror.dreams.dream_4_crown_con: A hundred broken crowns lie in a hall of dust. As you walk past, they rise and fit themselves together, point by point, into a single crown of gold. It does not descend onto your head. It waits for you to reach for it, and asks if you are certain.
crown_conqueror.memories.the_empty_thron: Aurex remembers a throne left empty for a full year, because no claimant would swear to serve the people before themselves. The kingdom endured that year better than any before it.
crown_conqueror.memories.the_last_king.t: Aurex remembers a king who walked into the enemy camp alone and unarmed to end a war his pride had started. He did not come back. The war ended that night.
crown_conqueror.memories.when_crowns_wer: Aurex remembers an age when rulers were chosen by the people who had followed them through famine and flood. In that age, every crown was heavy, and no one wanted one.
crown_conqueror.memories.the_first_kingd: Aurex remembers the first kingdom: twelve villages that chose to stand together against the dark. Their first law had five words. No one rules the unwilling.
crown_conqueror.quotes.positive.0: They followed because they chose to. Remember that.
crown_conqueror.quotes.positive.1: That is how a ruler answers.
crown_conqueror.quotes.positive.3: Mercy from the strong is law. Mercy from the weak is a plea.
crown_conqueror.quotes.positive.4: Your word held. So will they.
crown_conqueror.quotes.negative.1: You commanded from the back of the field.
crown_conqueror.quotes.negative.2: A crown of fear rusts quickly.
crown_conqueror.quotes.negative.3: They followed you into that. Answer for it.
crown_conqueror.quotes.negative.4: You spoke as a master, not a sovereign.
crown_conqueror.quotes.neutral.0: A crown is carried, never worn.
crown_conqueror.quotes.neutral.2: Who serves the one who rules?
crown_conqueror.quotes.neutral.3: Silence in the ranks is not agreement.
crown_conqueror.quotes.signature.0: I am Aurex. Kings have knelt to me. I have knelt to none of them.
crown_conqueror.quotes.signature.1: You have earned the right to command. Now earn it again tomorrow.
crown_conqueror.quotes.signature.2: Rise, sovereign. They are waiting for you.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.title: Aurex Awakens
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.0: Every voice nearby falls silent at once.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.1: A weight settles on your brow. There is nothing there, yet you could not lift it alone.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.2: Around you rise the shapes of kings and queens long dead, each wearing a broken crown.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.3: They do not bow. They watch, as a court watches a verdict.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.4: Then a voice of gold and iron speaks:
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.5: You commanded, and they were not diminished.
crown_conqueror.signatureCeremony.text.7: The crowns join into one, and its true name rings through you: Aurex, The Crown That United Kings.
crown_conqueror.lore.origin: Aurex was first worn by the leader of twelve villages who chose to stand together against the dark, and it has judged every ruler since. It does not care whether a bearer is born to rule. It cares only whether the people beneath their command become stronger or smaller.
crown_conqueror.lore.hiddenSorrow: Aurex remembers the first kingdom splitting because its king chose obedience over trust.
crown_conqueror.lore.knownRumor: Bards claim the crown refuses any ruler who cannot kneel beside the people they command.
crown_conqueror.lore.appearanceDormant: A tarnished circlet fragment or command medallion that feels heavier when orders are cruel.
crown_conqueror.lore.appearanceAwakened: Tiny script appears along the rim, recording oaths freely given.
crown_conqueror.lore.appearanceExalted: A phantom crown hovers above the bearer in moments of command, visible only in reflected light.
crown_conqueror.lore.appearanceSignature: Aurex becomes a full golden crown of many joined crowns, each point shaped like a raised standard.
bands_inner_dragon.name: Bands of the Inner Dragon
bands_inner_dragon.trueName.name: Ryushen
bands_inner_dragon.trueName.title: The Dragon Without Chains
bands_inner_dragon.personality.corePhras: The dragon is the breath, not the fire.
bands_inner_dragon.personality.roleplayG: Ryushen values discipline without cruelty and strength without performance. It answers practice, patience, restraint, and victories earned after failure.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.0.description: The bands rest like cool stone, waiting for breath and motion to align.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.1.description: A slow pulse follows moments when the bearer chooses patience over impulse.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.2.description: The bands test whether control remains when pain, insult, or fear breaks rhythm.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.3.description: The bands move with the bearer, correcting wasted motion before thought catches up.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.4.description: The relic accepts the bearer as a student who can become the lesson.
bands_inner_dragon.moodMap.5.description: A dragon exhales inside the bearer's breath; Ryushen is ready to speak its true name.
bands_inner_dragon.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
bands_inner_dragon.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
bands_inner_dragon.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
bands_inner_dragon.hiddenRequirements.ta: Take no damage in three combats.
bands_inner_dragon.hiddenRequirements.de: Defeat someone after losing to them.
bands_inner_dragon.hiddenRequirements.sp: Spend a long rest in silence.
bands_inner_dragon.features.passives.0: Centered Mind. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration.
bands_inner_dragon.features.passives.1: Perfect Motion. The first opportunity attack made against you each round has disadvantage.
bands_inner_dragon.features.passives.2: Body Beyond Limits. Your speed increases by 10 feet, and your jump distance is doubled.
bands_inner_dragon.features.passives.3: Flow State. When you fail a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
bands_inner_dragon.features.actives.0: Dragon Breath. Bonus Action, 1 charge, 1 minute. You ignore nonmagical difficult terrain, gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and add the relic bonus to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
bands_inner_dragon.features.actives.1: Iron Soul. Reaction, 2 charges. When you fail a saving throw, reroll it. The new result must be used.
bands_inner_dragon.features.actives.2: Hundred Forms. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and your AC increases by 2 while you are not incapacitated.
bands_inner_dragon.features.actives.3: Perfect Strike. Action, 4 charges. Focus your next hit before the end of your next turn. If it hits, the attack becomes a critical hit.
bands_inner_dragon.features.avatar: Inner Dragon Manifest. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. A translucent dragon coils around your limbs. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to force damage, +5 feet reach, and once per turn your unarmed strike or monk weapon hit deals an extra 2d10 force damage.
bands_inner_dragon.features.signature: Dragon Unbound. Once per long rest, 1 minute. You gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, your speed doubles, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, and force damage, and you are immune to stunned and restrained.
bands_inner_dragon.dreams.dream_1_bands_: You dream of a mountain so quiet that you can hear your own heartbeat echo from the peaks. You try to climb it and fall. You try again and fall again. On the third attempt, you notice the steps were carved there for you all along.
bands_inner_dragon.dreams.dream_2_bands_: A dragon lies coiled on a temple roof, perfectly still, eyes closed. Arrows strike its scales and fall away. It does not wake. When the archers tire and leave, it opens one eye and looks at you as if to ask whether you understood.
bands_inner_dragon.dreams.dream_3_bands_: You stand in an empty courtyard and strike the air a thousand times. On the thousandth strike there is no sound, no wind, no effort. There is only the strike, and for a moment, you are not there at all.
bands_inner_dragon.dreams.dream_4_bands_: Chains fall from your wrists, but you do not move. A great silver dragon uncoils from your own breath and circles you once. 'You could always have broken them,' it says. 'You learned to wait until breaking them meant something.'
bands_inner_dragon.memories.the_mountain: Ryushen remembers a student who climbed the same mountain path every dawn for twenty years. The mountain never changed. The student did.
bands_inner_dragon.memories.one_thousand: Ryushen remembers a thousand strikes against a temple pillar, and the morning the pillar was left untouched because the student finally understood when not to strike.
bands_inner_dragon.memories.the_silent_d: Ryushen remembers a dragon that let itself be called a coward rather than burn a valley that had insulted it. Its stillness saved more lives than any battle it ever fought.
bands_inner_dragon.memories.the_perfect_: Ryushen remembers a single breath, drawn in a burning temple, slow and complete. In that breath its bearer chose to carry the children out rather than chase the arsonist.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.positive.1: You did not need to strike. So you didn't.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.positive.3: Pain passed through you and left you standing.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.positive.4: You lost, and you learned. That is the only victory that lasts.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.negative.0: You fought the anger, and it won.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.negative.1: Who was that strike for? The enemy or the crowd?
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.negative.3: The defeated were already beaten. You struck them anyway.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.negative.4: You skipped the practice. The fight noticed.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.neutral.0: The dragon is the breath, not the fire.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.neutral.3: A closed fist is still an open choice.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.neutral.4: Mastery is the same lesson, learned forever.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.signature.0: I am Ryushen. I wore chains so that I would learn to choose.
bands_inner_dragon.quotes.signature.1: We move as one now. Do not mistake that for ease.
bands_inner_dragon.signatureCeremony.tex: Your breath slows until the world seems to slow with it.
The bands grow warm, then weightless, then gone, though you can still feel them on your wrists.
Behind your eyes, a silver dragon uncoils from a long, patient sleep.
It does not roar. It breathes once, in time with you.
A voice as calm as still water says:
You were strong enough to break your chains long ago.
You waited until you were wise enough to deserve it.
The true name moves through you like a perfect breath: Ryushen, The Dragon Without Chains.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.origin: Ryushen was born when a dragon chose to bind its own power rather than let its rage burn the world, and gave its chains to a mortal student so that the lesson would not be lost. The bands teach the same lesson still: true strength is the power to hold back.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.hiddenSorrow: Ryushen remembers the master who won every duel but failed to teach mercy before the temple burned.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.knownRumor: Monks say the bands tighten when worn for display and loosen only after honest practice.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.appearanceDorman: Plain iron training bands, perfectly balanced and almost impossible to scratch.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.appearanceAwaken: Scale-like seams appear when the bearer breathes slowly through pain.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.appearanceExalte: A faint dragon silhouette follows the bearer's movements half a heartbeat late.
bands_inner_dragon.lore.appearanceSignat: The bands become living rings of silver scale and warm breath, weightless until violence begins.
cloak_shadowfell.name: Cloak of the Umbral Veil
cloak_shadowfell.trueName.name: Noctyra
cloak_shadowfell.trueName.title: The Shadow That Never Slept
cloak_shadowfell.trueName.full: Noctyra, The Shadow That Never Slept
cloak_shadowfell.personality.likes.0: Plans that end danger before it begins
cloak_shadowfell.personality.likes.3: Mercy no one ever learns about
cloak_shadowfell.personality.likes.5: Protecting those who never knew they were in danger
cloak_shadowfell.personality.corePhrase: The best blade is the one never drawn.
cloak_shadowfell.personality.roleplayGui: Noctyra rewards patience, information, and clean plans that end danger before panic begins. It distrusts spectacle, needless lies, and cruelty disguised as cleverness.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.0.description: The cloak drinks light silently, waiting to see whether the bearer can wait as well.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.1.description: Its hem stirs toward hidden exits when the bearer gathers information before acting.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.2.description: The cloak tests plans by offering tempting shortcuts that would expose the innocent.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.3.description: The cloak trusts the bearer enough to hide their heartbeat from listening shadows.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.4.description: The relic accepts the bearer as a blade that can remain sheathed until the right moment.
cloak_shadowfell.moodMap.5.description: Every shadow turns its face toward the bearer; Noctyra is ready to speak its true name.
