cloak_shadowfell.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
cloak_shadowfell.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
cloak_shadowfell.hiddenRequirements.defe: Defeat a boss through a plan.
cloak_shadowfell.features.passives.0: Shadow Walker. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while you are in dim light or darkness.
cloak_shadowfell.features.passives.1: Veil of Silence. Your movement makes no sound, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect hidden creatures.
cloak_shadowfell.features.passives.2: One With Darkness. While you are in dim light or darkness, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.
cloak_shadowfell.features.passives.3: Unseen Hunter. You have advantage on the first attack roll you make in each combat. If that attack hits, it deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage.
cloak_shadowfell.features.actives.0: Shadow Step. Bonus Action, 1 charge. Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness that you can see.
cloak_shadowfell.features.actives.1: Fade Away. Reaction, 2 charges. When you are targeted by an attack or effect, become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.
cloak_shadowfell.features.actives.2: Living Darkness. Action, 3 charges. Create a zone of magical darkness at a point within 60 feet. The bearer can see through this darkness.
cloak_shadowfell.features.actives.3: Death From Silence. Action, 4 charges. Make a weapon attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, deal an extra 8d6 necrotic damage; the GM may call for a save to resist being stunned.
cloak_shadowfell.features.avatar: Walker Between Shadows. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to necrotic damage, may become invisible as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
cloak_shadowfell.features.signature: One Step Behind. Once per long rest, 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, you may teleport to a shadow within 60 feet. The first attack you make after each teleport has advantage and deals an extra 10d6 necrotic damage on a hit.
cloak_shadowfell.dreams.dream_1_cloak_sh: You dream of a city where the moon never rises. People walk its streets without lanterns, guided by whispers from the walls. One whisper speaks your name, then falls silent, as if it said too much.
cloak_shadowfell.dreams.dream_2_cloak_sh: A crown rests on a velvet cushion in an unguarded room. You could take it and no one would ever know. You leave it, and as you close the door, a shadow behind you laughs softly in approval.
cloak_shadowfell.dreams.dream_3_cloak_sh: Shadows gather around a table and speak to each other in low voices. They are planning something. When you sit down among them, they slide a map toward you and wait for your first move.
cloak_shadowfell.dreams.dream_4_cloak_sh: Every shadow in the world turns to face you at once. From the darkness steps a figure made of folded night, eyes like distant stars. 'I have watched you in every dark room,' it says. 'You never once wasted the dark.'
cloak_shadowfell.memories.the_city_witho: Noctyra remembers a city under siege where every lamp went dark on the same night. By dawn the enemy commanders were gone, the gates were open, and not one citizen had been harmed.
cloak_shadowfell.memories.when_silence_w: Noctyra remembers a war that ended without a battle, because a single letter reached the right hands at the right hour. No song was written about it. That was the point.
cloak_shadowfell.memories.the_unseen_que: Noctyra remembers a queen who ruled for forty years without anyone learning her face. She walked among her people in the dark and knew their troubles better than any crowned king.
cloak_shadowfell.memories.the_last_shado: Noctyra remembers its first bearer slipping away into the dark after saving a kingdom, leaving no name behind. The kingdom never thanked them. The cloak has never forgotten them.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.positive.0: Clean. No one will ever know.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.positive.1: You waited. That was the hardest part.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.positive.2: They never saw you coming. They never needed to.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.positive.4: You let them keep their secret. Wise.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.negative.0: That was noise, not a plan.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.negative.1: You lied when the truth would have served.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.negative.2: Everyone saw that. Everyone will remember.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.negative.3: Cruelty is not cleverness. It only looks like it in the dark.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.negative.4: You sold someone who trusted you.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.neutral.0: The best blade is the one never drawn.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.neutral.3: Patience is a dagger held very still.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.signature.0: I am Noctyra. I have never slept.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.signature.1: Wherever there is shadow, you are home now.
cloak_shadowfell.quotes.signature.2: Let them search the dark. They will find only us.
cloak_shadowfell.signatureCeremony.title: Noctyra Awakens
The light around you dims, though no flame has gone out.
Every shadow in the room leans toward you, as if it has been waiting to be noticed.
The cloak grows heavy with the weight of a thousand kept secrets.
Faces form in the folds: bearers who saved cities and were never thanked.
One of them leans close and whispers:
You learned to be unseen without becoming cruel.
Now the dark will hide you, and you will guard the dark.
The true name settles into you without a sound: Noctyra, The Shadow That Never Slept.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.origin: Noctyra was woven from the first night that ever kept a secret: the darkness in which a hunted people hid from those who would destroy them. The cloak still remembers what shadows are for. They are not for cruelty. They are for shelter.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.hiddenSorrow: Noctyra remembers the night a perfect plan saved a kingdom and left its planner forgotten in the dark.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.knownRumor: Thieves whisper that the cloak chooses those who know when not to strike.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.appearanceDormant: A matte black cloak clasp or strip of fabric that never catches torchlight directly.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.appearanceAwakened: Its folds show impossible depth, as if a second room waits inside the cloth.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.appearanceExalted: Shadows cling to the bearer like loyal informants, bending away from allies.
cloak_shadowfell.lore.appearanceSignatur: The cloak becomes a starless sky draped over the shoulders, with silent footsteps moving inside it.
heart_yggdrasil.name: Heart of Yggdrasil
heart_yggdrasil.trueName.name: Eldryss
heart_yggdrasil.trueName.title: The Heart That Never Withered
heart_yggdrasil.trueName.full: Eldryss, The Heart That Never Withered
heart_yggdrasil.personality.likes.5: Planting what you will never see grow
heart_yggdrasil.personality.corePhrase: What is planted in grief may still bloom.
heart_yggdrasil.personality.roleplayGuid: Eldryss honors growth that preserves balance: healing, restoration, mercy, and patient renewal. It withers around wasteful destruction or life taken for convenience.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.0.description: A dry seed-heart waits in silence, listening for compassion beneath the bearer's choices.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.1.description: Tiny green veins wake across the relic when the bearer restores what others would abandon.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.2.description: The heart tests whether mercy can survive hunger, anger, and fear of loss.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.3.description: The heart beats with the bearer's pulse and steadies wounded creatures nearby.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.4.description: The relic accepts the bearer as soil where ruined things may grow again.
heart_yggdrasil.moodMap.5.description: Roots coil through dream and bone; Eldryss is ready to speak its true name.
heart_yggdrasil.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
heart_yggdrasil.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
heart_yggdrasil.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
heart_yggdrasil.features.passives.0: Living Sap. When you finish a long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
heart_yggdrasil.features.passives.1: Nature's Blessing. Whenever you regain hit points from a spell, potion, or feature, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
heart_yggdrasil.features.passives.2: Endless Spring. The first time an ally within 30 feet of you drops to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 hit point instead. Once this feature saves an ally, it can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
heart_yggdrasil.features.passives.3: World Tree's Gift. You are immune to the poisoned condition and to disease.
heart_yggdrasil.features.actives.0: Verdant Bloom. Action, 1 charge. Cause plants and roots to surge in an area within 60 feet. Enemies treat the area as difficult terrain while allies move through it normally.
heart_yggdrasil.features.actives.1: Nature's Embrace. Bonus Action, 2 charges. A creature within 30 feet regains 4d8 hit points.
heart_yggdrasil.features.actives.2: Forest Guardian. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You project a protective growth aura. Allies in the aura gain resistance to one damage type chosen by the GM from the current threat.
heart_yggdrasil.features.actives.3: Roots of Eternity. Action, 4 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is restrained by ancient roots for 1 minute.
heart_yggdrasil.features.avatar: Avatar of Yggdrasil. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Branches and living light surround you. You gain flying speed 30 feet with hover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage, and allies who start their turn near you regain hit points equal to the relic bonus.
heart_yggdrasil.features.signature: World Reborn. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 60 feet regain all hit points, end poisoned and diseased, and reduce exhaustion by 1. Enemies chosen by the GM in the renewal surge take 8d8 radiant or force damage.
heart_yggdrasil.dreams.dream_1_heart_ygg: You dream of a vast tree without a single leaf, standing in a field of grey dust. You lay your palm on its bark and feel, deep beneath your hand, something still beating. Very slowly. Very faintly.
heart_yggdrasil.dreams.dream_2_heart_ygg: A single green leaf opens on a dead branch above you. It trembles in a wind you cannot feel. Below it, in the dust, the first blade of grass pushes up toward the light.
heart_yggdrasil.dreams.dream_3_heart_ygg: The wind moves through a forest that has not yet grown, and you can hear it singing through branches that will exist in a hundred years. The song is about you, and it is not finished.
heart_yggdrasil.dreams.dream_4_heart_ygg: You stand within the trunk of the first world-tree, surrounded by the heartbeat of every forest that ever lived. A voice like rain on new leaves says: 'Everything you healed is still growing. Come and see.'
Eldryss remembers the first seed, planted in ash by a druid who had lost everything to fire. She never lived to see it sprout. It became the first forest of the new world.
heart_yggdrasil.memories.roots_beneath_t: Eldryss remembers roots that reached beneath the whole world, holding the land together through an age of earthquakes. No one saw them. Everything stood because of them.
heart_yggdrasil.memories.when_forests_sa: Eldryss remembers an age when the forests sang aloud and every traveler could understand them. The song ended when the first forest was cut down for profit. Some trees still remember the melody.
heart_yggdrasil.memories.the_last_spring: Eldryss remembers a winter that lasted nine years, and the single spring flower its bearer kept alive in their hands through all of it. When the thaw came, that flower seeded a valley.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.positive.0: It will grow back. Because of you.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.positive.1: You healed what others left to die.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.positive.2: That was a seed. Be patient with it.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.negative.0: That did not need to die.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.negative.1: You burned what you could have healed.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.negative.3: You took and gave nothing back.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.negative.4: Something withered just now. It was not only the grass.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.neutral.0: What is planted in grief may still bloom.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.neutral.1: Growth is slow. So is healing.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.neutral.4: Water the roots, not the leaves.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.signature.0: I am Eldryss. I have never withered.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.signature.1: Wherever you walk now, something will grow.
heart_yggdrasil.quotes.signature.2: Grief and growth share the same roots. You know that now.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.title: Eldryss Awakens
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.0: The ground beneath your feet grows warm, and the air smells of rain.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.1: Green threads spread from your hands into the earth, and the earth answers.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.2: All around you, things that should not bloom are blooming: stone, rust, ash.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.3: You feel the slow heartbeat of every forest at once, and your own heart slows to match it.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.4: A voice like wind through a canopy says:
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.5: You healed what the world gave up on.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.6: Now the world will grow wherever you walk.
heart_yggdrasil.signatureCeremony.text.7: The true name takes root in you: Eldryss, The Heart That Never Withered.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.origin: Eldryss is the heartwood of the first world-tree, from whose roots every forest grew. It carries the memory of every forest that grew from its roots, and every forest that was lost. It asks only one thing of its bearers: to plant more than they take.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.hiddenSorrow: Eldryss remembers the first world-tree losing a single branch to save a burning forest below.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.knownRumor: Druids say the heart blooms only for those who understand that growth and grief share roots.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.appearanceDormant: A petrified seed or heartwood charm with one living green line at its center.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.appearanceAwakened: Leaves grow from it overnight and fade into light when plucked.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.appearanceExalted: A miniature canopy of spectral branches spreads behind the bearer in moments of healing.
heart_yggdrasil.lore.appearanceSignature: The heart becomes a living knot of root, leaf, and starlight, beating with the rhythm of distant forests.
vestments_first_saint.name: Vestments of the First Saint
vestments_first_saint.trueName.name: Seraphel
vestments_first_saint.trueName.title: The Light That Refused to Fade
vestments_first_saint.trueName.full: Seraphel, The Light That Refused to Fade
vestments_first_saint.personality.temper: Fierce in defense of the suffering
Hope offered when it seems foolish
vestments_first_saint.personality.corePh: Light is only light if it reaches the dark.
vestments_first_saint.personality.rolepl: Seraphel answers faith expressed through mercy, courage, and service rather than doctrine alone. It dims when healing is withheld for pride or compassion is treated as weakness.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.0.descript: The vestments hang still, smelling faintly of candle smoke after prayers for the wounded.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.1.descript: Threaded light appears along the seams when the bearer comforts someone with no reward promised.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.2.descript: The vestments test whether faith remains when miracles are delayed and pain is inconvenient.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.3.descript: The relic trusts the bearer with warmth that steadies frightened hands.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.4.descript: The vestments accept the bearer as a servant of light before victory.
vestments_first_saint.moodMap.5.descript: A choir too distant to hear gathers in the cloth; Seraphel is ready to speak its true name.
vestments_first_saint.hiddenRequirements: Bring an ally back from death.
Be the last healer in a disaster.
Gentle Light. Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on death saving throws.
Saint's Grace. When you restore hit points to a creature with a spell or feature, it regains additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
Beacon of Hope. Allies within 30 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.
Unyielding Spirit. When a spell or effect would kill you outright, you can reject it and drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
vestments_first_saint.features.actives.0: Blessing. Bonus Action, 1 charge. An ally within 30 feet adds 1d4 to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks until the end of your next turn.
vestments_first_saint.features.actives.1: Cleansing Light. Action, 2 charges. End one poison, disease, frightened, or charmed condition affecting a creature within 30 feet.
vestments_first_saint.features.actives.2: Sanctuary of Dawn. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You create a 10-foot aura of sanctuary. Allies in the aura gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
vestments_first_saint.features.actives.3: Wings of Mercy. Action, 4 charges. Up to three allies within 60 feet each regain 6d8 hit points. Wings of light carry the healing around cover at the GM's discretion.
vestments_first_saint.features.avatar: Saint Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Wings and vestments of light form around you. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to radiant damage, shed bright light, and allies near you regain hit points equal to the relic bonus at the start of their turns.
vestments_first_saint.features.signature: Miracle of the First Saint. Once per long rest. Allies of your choice within 60 feet are fully healed and cleansed of poison, disease, frightened, charmed, paralyzed, and stunned. One ally who died within the last minute may return to life at 1 hit point.
vestments_first_saint.dreams.dream_1_ves: You dream of an empty temple. Its altar is bare and its candles are cold. Outside its doors, someone is crying in the rain. The temple does not move toward them. You do.
vestments_first_saint.dreams.dream_2_ves: You walk across a battlefield after the fighting has ended. The wounded call out in a dozen languages, some in your own, some in the enemy's. In the dream you cannot tell which is which, and you realize it does not matter.
vestments_first_saint.dreams.dream_3_ves: A long night ends. The first ray of dawn falls not on a cathedral, but on a small hut where someone has been keeping vigil beside a sick child. The child opens their eyes.
vestments_first_saint.dreams.dream_4_ves: You stand in a field of light so bright you should not be able to see, yet you see everything. A figure in white-gold robes kneels before you and takes your hands. 'You carried the light into places it had never been,' they say. 'Now let it carry you.'
vestments_first_saint.memories.the_first: Seraphel remembers the first prayer it ever heard. It was not for wealth or victory. It was a mother asking that her child's fever break, and promising nothing in return.
vestments_first_saint.memories.when_hope: Seraphel remembers a plague city where no healer would enter, and the one who walked through its gates anyway. They saved few, but for the first time in months, the city stopped despairing.
vestments_first_saint.memories.the_empty: Seraphel remembers a grand cathedral emptied by its own priests when the war reached its doors. Its bearer stayed behind and turned the nave into a hospital for both armies.
vestments_first_saint.memories.light_bey: Seraphel remembers holding the hand of a dying soldier who feared the dark. It shone a little brighter so that the last thing the soldier saw was light.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.positive.0: They will live. Because you stayed.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.positive.1: That mercy was not owed. You gave it anyway.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.positive.3: You healed an enemy. Few understand how holy that is.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.positive.4: Hope is lighter when it is shared.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.negative.0: You could have healed them. You chose not to.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.negative.1: Faith without mercy is only noise.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.negative.2: You turned away. The light did not follow you.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.negative.3: They needed you, not your sermon.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.negative.4: Pride is a poor reason to let someone suffer.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.neutral.0: Light is only light if it reaches the dark.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.neutral.2: Mercy first. Judgment later, if at all.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.neutral.3: Even a candle defies the night.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.neutral.4: Every wound is a prayer someone cannot say aloud.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.signature.0: I am Seraphel. I refused to fade.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.signature.1: Wherever you walk, the dark will remember being lit.
vestments_first_saint.quotes.signature.2: Rise, saint. There is so much left to heal.
Warmth spreads through you, like the first sun after a long winter.
The vestments stir without wind, and light gathers in their folds.
You hear voices, thousands of them, every person ever healed by a bearer of this cloth.
They are not praising you. They are thanking you.
A voice as soft as a hand on a fevered brow says:
You brought light where no one else would go.
Now the light will never leave you.
The true name blooms in your heart: Seraphel, The Light That Refused to Fade.
vestments_first_saint.lore.origin: Seraphel was woven from the robes of the first healer to walk onto a battlefield and tend the wounded of both sides. No temple claims to have sent that healer, and every temple claims them now. The vestments remember only that they went where they were needed.
vestments_first_saint.lore.hiddenSorrow: Seraphel remembers the saint who spent their final miracle on an enemy child and died unnamed.
vestments_first_saint.lore.knownRumor: Temples disagree about Seraphel's doctrine, but every story agrees the vestments move toward suffering.
vestments_first_saint.lore.appearanceDor: A strip of white-gold cloth or stole that never stains where blood touches it.
vestments_first_saint.lore.appearanceAwa: Soft script appears in the weave after acts of mercy, then vanishes by dawn.
vestments_first_saint.lore.appearanceExa: A halo of cloth and light trails the bearer, folding itself around the wounded.
vestments_first_saint.lore.appearanceSig: The vestments become radiant robes of impossible softness, stitched with prayers in every known tongue.
blood_first_dragon.name: Blood of the First Dragon
blood_first_dragon.trueName.name: Vorathis
blood_first_dragon.trueName.title: The Flame That Refused Extinction
blood_first_dragon.trueName.full: Vorathis, The Flame That Refused Extinction
blood_first_dragon.personality.temperame: Scornful of cowardice and tyranny alike
Begging for mercy one never offered
blood_first_dragon.personality.corePhras: Fire must choose what it burns.
blood_first_dragon.personality.roleplayG: Vorathis respects will that endures without surrendering to mindless destruction. It burns hotter when the bearer chooses purpose over rage and accepts the cost of power.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.0.description: The blood is dark and still, waiting to learn what the bearer will burn for.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.1.description: Heat rises beneath the relic when the bearer refuses fear without lashing out blindly.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.2.description: The dragon-blood tests whether the bearer can carry wrath without becoming its servant.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.3.description: The relic trusts the bearer with a controlled flame that answers breath and heartbeat.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.4.description: The dragon-blood accepts the bearer as one whose will can survive its own fire.
blood_first_dragon.moodMap.5.description: A first flame coils behind the bearer's eyes; Vorathis is ready to speak its true name.
blood_first_dragon.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
blood_first_dragon.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
blood_first_dragon.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
blood_first_dragon.features.passives.0: Draconic Blood. Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each of your character levels.
blood_first_dragon.features.passives.1: Ancient Scales. You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
blood_first_dragon.features.passives.2: Unyielding Will. You have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
blood_first_dragon.features.passives.3: Dragon Soul. You have resistance to fire and cold damage, and you are immune to the frightened condition.
blood_first_dragon.features.actives.0: Draconic Roar. Bonus Action, 1 charge. One creature within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
blood_first_dragon.features.actives.1: Burning Blood. Bonus Action, 2 charges, 1 minute. Your weapon and spell attacks deal an extra 2d6 fire damage once per turn.
blood_first_dragon.features.actives.2: Wings of the First Dragon. Action, 3 charges, 1 minute. You gain flying speed 60 feet with hover as wings of elemental flame unfold from your back.
blood_first_dragon.features.actives.3: Primordial Breath. Action, 4 charges. Exhale a 60-foot cone of primordial fire. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
blood_first_dragon.features.avatar: First Dragon Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. You gain flying speed 80 feet with hover, resistance to fire, cold, and lightning damage, a frightful draconic presence, and once per turn your damage deals an extra 2d10 fire, cold, or lightning damage.
blood_first_dragon.features.signature: Heart of the First Flame. Once per long rest, 1 minute. You gain flying speed, resistance to all damage, advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and your weapon and spell attacks score critical hits on a 19 or 20. When it ends, you gain one level of exhaustion.
blood_first_dragon.dreams.dream_1_blood_: You dream of an empty sky, wider than any you have seen. You are flying, alone, and there is nothing above you and nothing ahead. It is not peaceful. It is lonely, and the loneliness has teeth.
blood_first_dragon.dreams.dream_2_blood_: Your heart beats so loudly that the mountains answer. Each beat sends heat through your veins until you are sure you will burn up. You do not. You learn, slowly, to beat in rhythm with the fire.
blood_first_dragon.dreams.dream_3_blood_: A great dragon breathes fire over a frozen world. It does not destroy. The ice melts, rivers run, and green things wake. The dragon looks at you and asks: 'Do you understand now what fire is for?'
blood_first_dragon.dreams.dream_4_blood_: Chains of black iron are offered to a dragon on a burning mountain. It refuses them and burns rather than bow. From its ashes rises a single flame, and the flame turns toward you. 'I refused to end,' it says. 'So will you.'
blood_first_dragon.memories.the_first_fl: Vorathis remembers the first flame in the world, small and frightened in the cold. The first dragon breathed on it, and it grew. Every fire since then has carried a little of that breath.
blood_first_dragon.memories.before_drago: Vorathis remembers an age before dragons were kings, when they were only the largest things that dared to fly. They earned the sky one storm at a time.
blood_first_dragon.memories.wings_agains: Vorathis remembers a dragon flying straight into the dark between the stars to stop something vast from entering the world. It came back with its wings in tatters. The sky was still there.
blood_first_dragon.memories.the_burning_: Vorathis remembers a sky set on fire by dragons fighting over who would rule. The first dragon did not join them. It flew below, carrying the ones who were fleeing the flames.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.positive.2: You fell. You rose. That is the whole lesson.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.positive.3: Power, chosen with care, is not a curse.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.negative.0: You were afraid, and you let it decide.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.negative.2: You raised your strength against the weak. Disgraceful.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.negative.3: Rage is not power. It is surrender.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.negative.4: You wasted what a dragon died to give you.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.neutral.0: Fire must choose what it burns.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.neutral.2: Strength is a debt. Know who holds it.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.neutral.4: The sky is wide enough for both of us.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.signature.0: I am Vorathis. I refused extinction.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.signature.1: We burn together now. Choose well what we burn.
blood_first_dragon.quotes.signature.2: Let them bring their chains. We have refused chains before.
blood_first_dragon.signatureCeremony.tex: Heat rises in your blood, but it does not burn. It sings.
Your heartbeat thunders, and for a moment you hear another beating beside it, vast and ancient.
Shadows of great wings unfold across the ground around you.
You feel the memory of a mountain burning, and a will that would not bow.
A voice like a forge roaring to life speaks:
You carried fire without becoming ash.
You chose what to burn, and what to spare.
The true name ignites within you: Vorathis, The Flame That Refused Extinction.
blood_first_dragon.lore.origin: Vorathis is the last ember of the first dragon, the first creature to fly and the first to refuse a master. Its blood carries that refusal. It will lend its fire to any bearer brave enough to wield it, but it will never serve a tyrant.
blood_first_dragon.lore.hiddenSorrow: Vorathis remembers the first dragon choosing extinction over chains, and the mountain that became its pyre.
blood_first_dragon.lore.knownRumor: Sorcerers say the blood refuses cowards and tyrants in equal measure; both waste fire.
blood_first_dragon.lore.appearanceDorman: A ruby-dark vial, scale, or vein-like gem that warms near open flame.
blood_first_dragon.lore.appearanceAwaken: The relic pulses like a second heart when the bearer refuses fear.
blood_first_dragon.lore.appearanceExalte: Draconic script burns beneath its surface, visible through smoke and battle heat.
blood_first_dragon.lore.appearanceSignat: The blood becomes liquid starlit flame, circling the bearer like a dragon around its hoard.
lyre_first_song.name: Lyre of the First Song
lyre_first_song.trueName.name: Elyndor
lyre_first_song.trueName.title: The Song Before Stars
lyre_first_song.personality.corePhrase: Every silence is waiting for a song.
lyre_first_song.personality.roleplayGuid: Elyndor honors creation that gives courage, memory, and shape to hope. It falls silent around mockery that breaks spirits or art used only to manipulate the vulnerable.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.0.description: The lyre gives no note, but nearby silence feels arranged rather than empty.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.1.description: A single harmonic answers when the bearer uses voice or art to strengthen another.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.2.description: The lyre tests whether the bearer creates truth when lies would be easier to sing.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.3.description: The relic trusts the bearer with melodies that steady allies before fear can name itself.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.4.description: The lyre accepts the bearer as a maker whose song can carry others through darkness.
lyre_first_song.moodMap.5.description: The first note waits behind every sound; Elyndor is ready to speak its true name.
lyre_first_song.stages.dormant.title: Dormant
lyre_first_song.stages.awakened.title: Awakened
lyre_first_song.stages.exalted.title: Exalted
lyre_first_song.hiddenRequirements.resto: Restore hope to a broken NPC.
lyre_first_song.features.passives.0: Echo of Inspiration. Allies within 30 feet of you add the relic bonus to their ability checks.
lyre_first_song.features.passives.1: Song of Courage. Allies within 30 feet of you can't be frightened.
lyre_first_song.features.passives.2: Melody of Unity. Allies within 30 feet of you add your proficiency bonus to their saving throws.
lyre_first_song.features.passives.3: Symphony Eternal. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, you can choose to succeed instead. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses when you finish a long rest.
lyre_first_song.features.actives.0: Song of Rest. Action, 1 charge. Allies of your choice within 30 feet regain 2d8 hit points as the first chord restores breath and courage.
lyre_first_song.features.actives.1: Ballad of Heroes. Bonus Action, 2 charges, 1 minute. You create a 30-foot aura. Allies in the aura gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.
lyre_first_song.features.actives.2: Verse of Silence. Action, 3 charges. A creature within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is silenced for 1 minute.
lyre_first_song.features.actives.3: Chorus of Creation. Action, 4 charges, 1 minute. Allies in a 30-foot aura have advantage on saving throws, gain +2 AC, and gain temporary hit points equal to 10 + the relic bonus.
lyre_first_song.features.avatar: First Song Incarnate. Bonus Action, 8 charges, 1 minute. Music becomes visible around you. You gain flying speed 40 feet with hover, resistance to radiant and psychic damage, allies near you gain advantage against charm and fear, and your healing songs restore extra hit points equal to the relic bonus.
lyre_first_song.features.signature: The First Song. Once per long rest, 1 minute. Allies of your choice within 60 feet gain advantage on saving throws and ability checks, +2 AC, +2 to attack rolls, and regeneration 10. Enemies of your choice must make a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for the duration.
lyre_first_song.dreams.dream_1_lyre_firs: You dream of a silence so complete that you can hear the world waiting. Then a single note sounds, clear and impossibly old. Everything holds its breath to hear what comes next.
lyre_first_song.dreams.dream_2_lyre_firs: You stand in the dark before the world was made, and you watch the stars being sung into being. Each note becomes a point of light. One of them, small and faint, is still waiting for its note.
lyre_first_song.dreams.dream_3_lyre_firs: You walk through a hall where the other First Relics rest on stone pedestals. They are silent, as if listening for something. When you play a single chord, each of them hums softly in reply.
lyre_first_song.dreams.dream_4_lyre_firs: Music fills the whole sky, and you are inside it. Every song you have ever played echoes back to you, changed by the people who heard it. A voice made of every melody at once sings: 'You did not only play the song. You let it change the world.'
lyre_first_song.memories.before_stars_sa: Elyndor remembers the dark before the stars, when there was nothing to hear and no one to hear it. It remembers longing for the first listener more than for the first note.
lyre_first_song.memories.the_first_melod: Elyndor remembers the first melody: three notes hummed by a frightened child to keep the dark away. The dark did not leave. But the child was no longer afraid of it.
lyre_first_song.memories.the_choir_of_cr: Elyndor remembers the great choir that sang the world into shape. It remembers that no voice in that choir was the loudest. That was why it worked.
lyre_first_song.memories.when_silence_en: Elyndor remembers a war that went silent when a singer stepped between the armies and began to play. No one remembers the singer's name now. Everyone remembers the peace.
lyre_first_song.quotes.positive.0: Did you hear that? They sang along.
lyre_first_song.quotes.positive.1: That song will outlive us both.
lyre_first_song.quotes.positive.2: You gave them courage, not orders.
lyre_first_song.quotes.positive.3: Something new exists now, because of you.
lyre_first_song.quotes.positive.4: Harmony is harder than solo. You chose it anyway.
lyre_first_song.quotes.negative.0: That was cruel, and you called it a joke.
lyre_first_song.quotes.negative.1: You used the song as a leash.
lyre_first_song.quotes.negative.2: Their voice mattered too. You drowned it.
lyre_first_song.quotes.negative.3: You broke something someone made with love.
lyre_first_song.quotes.negative.4: A lie set to music is still a lie.
lyre_first_song.quotes.neutral.0: Every silence is waiting for a song.
lyre_first_song.quotes.neutral.3: What story are we telling today?
lyre_first_song.quotes.neutral.4: One note can change the key of everything.
lyre_first_song.quotes.signature.0: I am Elyndor. I was singing before the stars.
lyre_first_song.quotes.signature.1: Every song you play now is a little bit of creation.
lyre_first_song.quotes.signature.2: Sing, and let the world answer.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.title: Elyndor Awakens
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.0: Every sound around you fades: wind, breath, footsteps, heartbeat.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.1: In the silence, a single note rings out, older than the stars.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.2: The lyre's strings begin to glow, and new strings appear where none were strung.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.3: You hear every song ever written to give someone courage, all at once, in perfect harmony.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.4: A voice made of music sings:
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.5: You made things that did not exist before.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.6: You gave the silent a voice.
lyre_first_song.signatureCeremony.text.7: The true name resonates through every string: Elyndor, The Song Before Stars.
lyre_first_song.lore.origin: Elyndor is the first note of the song that sang the stars into being, caught and kept in strings by the first mortal who heard it and wept. It does not care for fame or applause. It cares whether a song left its listeners braver, kinder, or less alone.
lyre_first_song.lore.hiddenSorrow: Elyndor remembers the first song ending a war, and the singer who was forgotten once peace became ordinary.
lyre_first_song.lore.knownRumor: Bards claim the lyre cannot be tuned; it tunes the room, the heart, and sometimes history.
lyre_first_song.lore.appearanceDormant: A small lyre, string, or tuning key that hums faintly near honest grief.
lyre_first_song.lore.appearanceAwakened: New strings appear after songs that give courage to the afraid.
lyre_first_song.lore.appearanceExalted: Notes of colored light drift from it even when no hand touches the strings.
lyre_first_song.lore.appearanceSignature: The lyre becomes a constellation of strings and sound, each note echoing before it is played.
